seoPage.title: EVs practical for apartment living & home charging | EVSavari
seoPage.metaDescription: Apartment-friendly EV picks — home AC charging support, wallbox practicality, and charging ecosystem notes.
seoPage.intro: Apartment living picks prioritize home AC charging support, wallbox practicality, and lower charging friction for shared parking setups. We explain tradeoffs — not every EV fits every society parking rule.

recommendationLogic.methodology: Deterministic composite of internal recommendation scores (70% primary, 30% secondary average). No manual ranking overrides.

faq.question: Which EV works for apartment living?
faq.answer: Apartment picks prioritize home AC charging support and lower charging friction; society permissions and parking still matter.

faq.question: What is the top pick on this page?
faq.answer: Tata Creative+ is currently highest on our apartment living composite (score 81, medium confidence). This is not a universal "best EV" claim — review tradeoffs below.

faq.question: What is the ex-showroom price of Tata Creative+?
faq.answer: Indicative ex-showroom from catalog: ₹14.49 lakh. Confirm on-road price with a dealer in your city.
